output.notes: Described full Primer as used in the 1.9B one-shot experiment (without shared QK). The 1.9B sizes are stated for the baseline Transformer, and Primer is compared 'at 1.9B parameters', so I assumed the same sizes. The 12X bottleneck projection, post-softmax spatial gating and extraneous modifications (e.g. multiplication by -1.12, duplicated residual adds in the program listing) are excluded per the paper. Norm affine order follows standard gain*x+bias. The appendix table swaps the SCALE/SHIFT labels, which I treated as ambiguous. Head counts, vocab, biases, eps, tying and final norm are not stated. Primer-EZ is the simpler recommended variant: a vanilla Transformer plus MDHA and squared ReLU.
